hero.titleStart: Prepare for the NMT in maths —

faq.title: The short answers
faq.lead: What people ask most often before signing up.

price.a: The student workspace is free: sign-up, topic tests, results and recommendations are available as soon as you create an account.

who.a: Students in years 10–11, past graduates and adults returning to maths. You choose the pace and the workload.

mobile.q: Can I study on a phone?
mobile.a: Yes. The interface is mobile-first: tests, the simulator and statistics work equally well on a phone, tablet and desktop.

recommendations.a: The system looks at your answers per topic and suggests revising the ones with the lowest share of correct answers before moving on.

teacher.q: Can I work with a teacher?
teacher.a: Yes. A teacher sees your results and can assign mentor sessions — separate practice for specific gaps.

cta.title: Start with your first topic today
cta.lead: Create a student account in a minute and take the first test to see your real level.
